sentences.text: CORAM: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE ANIL KUMAR CHOUDHARY ------

For the Petitioner : Mr. P.K. Choudhary, Advocate For the State : Mr. V.S. Sahay, Addl. P.P. For O.P.
No.2 : Mr. Madhav Prasad, Advocate ------
Order No.06 Dated- 15.09.2023 Heard the parties.

The petitioner has moved this Court for grant of bail in connection with Mahila P.S. Kiriburu (Noamundi) Case No.01 of 2019 registered under sections 498A/506/34 of the Indian Penal Code and under Section 3/4 of D.P. Act.

The learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner has been given the privilege of provisional bail vide order dated 29.03.2023 for a period of six months and the petitioner has furnished the bail bond in connection with the said order and he is on provisional bail.

It is then submitted that the petitioner is ready and willing to resume conjugal life with the opposite party no.2 but the opposite party no.2 is not ready and willing to resume conjugal life with the petitioner which fact is also admitted by the learned counsel for the opposite party no.2.
Hence, it is submitted that the provisional bail granted to the petitioner be confirmed till disposal of Mahila P.S. Kiriburu (Noamundi) Case No.01 of 2019.

Considering the aforesaid facts, the provisional bail granted to the petitioner vide order dated 29.03.2023 is confirmed till disposal of Mahila P.S. Kiriburu (Noamundi) Case No.01 of 2019 with the condition that the petitioner will cooperate with the trial of the case.
